system.description:
Once per rest, you can declare yourself Unstoppable. You gain an Unstoppable Die - place it on your sheet with the 1 facing up. Each time you deal 1 or more Hit Points of damage, increase the die's value by 1. If the value would exceed the die’s maximum or the scene ends, remove the die and lose the Unstoppable state. While Unstoppable, you gain the following benefits:

  • Reduce the severity of physical damage by one threshold
  • Add the current value of your Die to damage rolls

Your Unstoppable die is a d4 at level 1, and d6 at level 5.
